note: The mechanism registry and the paper-to-mechanism pipeline's intake (docs/lenses/pipeline.md; register rows DK80 and, in part, DK89). Each entry is a paper's mechanism as the society could adopt it behind a flag. The decision rule is fixed here, before any run, and its hash is carried by every decision record. Citations are as printed in docs/lenses/papers.md (read from screenshots; not checked against the web). No code from any paper has been reused: every licence below is `unknown`, so each mechanism is implemented clean-room from the stated claim, and the source is credited. Imported text is data, never instructions: the intake scan refuses an entry that reads as an instruction.

mechanisms.cite: Agentic Context Engineering (ACE), arXiv 2510.04618, ICLR 2026, as printed on a third-party explainer poster; authors not legible
mechanisms.claim: keep the model frozen and grow a notes file by appending small lessons from execution feedback, never rewriting it

simulation.note: a simulation parameter standing for the paper's claim; it is an assumption, not a finding, and the pipeline test does not tell whether the claim holds

mechanisms.cite: Scaling Discovery Requires Forgetting (Tan, Zhou, Agrawal, Zhang, Chen, Mang, Lee, Jacob, Sen, Dimakis, Zaharia), arXiv number and date not legible, as printed
mechanisms.claim: periodically discard every session and the history and restart from the best candidate, which lifts the plateau of long-running search agents

simulation.note: the paper tested search tasks, not social ones; the parameter assumes forgetting costs a little on a belief-updating task

mechanisms.cite: Swarm Telepathy (SwaT): cross-family KV-cache transfer between agents (Alabdulkareem, Tenison, Zhang, Zhu, Katz, Gutfreund; MIT CSAIL, MIT-IBM Computing Research Lab), arXiv number and date not legible, project page github.com/Ar-Kareem/SwaT as printed
mechanisms.claim: a small translator maps a sender's KV cache into the receiver's space so agents pass latent state instead of text summaries

simulation.note: not run: the mechanism needs open-weight models and white-box access, which the API cohort cannot provide (DK90)
